_comment: Newest release first. The update dialog previews the entries newer than the running version; the About dialog shows the current one.

releases.title: Your Mods, Your Folder
highlights: The game folder button now opens the client folder where mods live
Mods you add yourself are kept across launcher restarts and pack updates
notes: Changed: 'Open game folder' now opens the Minecraft client folder (mods, config, resourcepacks) instead of the launcher's data root.
Fixed: mods you install yourself are no longer swept away when the modpack updates - only the launcher's own outdated jars are removed.

releases.title: Onboarding & Diagnostics
highlights: A first-run guide that checks your computer before you play
Downloads now resume where they stopped and retry by themselves
One-click diagnostic report for when something goes wrong
Game data moved out of Documents into AppData, automatically
notes: Added: first-run setup guide with a live system check (disk, memory, Java, network).
Added: download speed and time remaining on the progress bar.
Added: automatic retry with exponential backoff, and resume of interrupted downloads.
Added: diagnostic report bundle - logs, settings and system details in one redacted file.
Added: Report Issue button that opens GitHub with the details already filled in.
Added: keyboard shortcuts - P to play, S for settings, L for the log, Escape to close.
Added: activity log filtering, search and export.
Added: player data is backed up before it is reset.
Changed: game data now lives in AppData instead of Documents; existing installs are moved automatically.
Changed: Settings is split into Memory, Graphics, Network, Behaviour and Diagnostics.
Changed: help now includes a searchable FAQ and step-by-step fixes for common problems.
Changed: the launch progress bar is weighted, so it no longer sits still during the long steps.

releases.title: Hogwarts Edition
highlights: Microsoft sign-in with encrypted token storage
Automatic crash recovery for the world server
notes: Added: Microsoft device-code sign-in; tokens stored in the OS credential store.
Added: world server crash supervision with automatic restart.
Added: macOS .app bundle and Linux support.
Changed: memory is now sized from the machine's RAM instead of a fixed 6 GB.
Fixed: orphaned Java processes holding ports after a hard crash.

releases.title: Modpack & Ops
highlights: Client mods now install from Modrinth instead of shipping in the installer
The world plays like singleplayer: operator commands, flight, no spawn protection
Skins render correctly for everyone on the offline-mode server
Repeat launches skip work that's already done
notes: Added: client modpack (Fabulously Optimized) installed and verified by SHA-512 from Modrinth on first run, replacing the bundled mod jars.
Added: CustomSkinLoader so player skins render correctly on the offline-mode server.
Added: install-state cache so Fabric, the modpack, the resource pack and the server list are skipped once already up to date.
Added: server.properties now forces operator-level permissions, flight and disables spawn protection, and the player is auto-opped so the world plays like the singleplayer map it's based on.
Added: the launcher window gets its own icon when run from a source checkout.
Changed: "Clear Player Data" now reinstalls the world from the local cache instead of re-downloading it.
Changed: refreshed branding - new app icon and logo, and an "unofficial launcher" label on the author credit.
